entries.zh: 安排就位；安设尊位（指为有身份者布置座位、职位）
entries.en: to arrange the seat/place of dignity; to install (someone) in an office

entries.zh: 安排座椅；布置座位（供人安座）
entries.en: to set up or prepare the chair/seat

entries.zh: 预备妥当、收拾停当；便利
entries.en: prepared, made ready; convenient

entries.zh: 效死；甘愿赴死、视死如归
entries.en: ready to die; to devote oneself unto death

entries.zh: 为他烹调（用油）；给他做了一道菜
entries.en: he prepared/cooked (a dish) with oil for him
entries.notes: 西语为叙事句式（aparejole una buelta de açeyte），汉语对以『烹調伊』。

entries.zh: 相貌；外形、姿态
entries.en: appearance, outward figure

entries.zh: 相貌；容貌、外表
entries.en: appearance, countenance, features

entries.zh: 态度；仪态（原稿闽南语栏残缺，释义存疑）
entries.en: demeanour, bearing (Hokkien column damaged; gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: source_M 为 [残]，据西语 apariencia 与汉字『態』推断。

entries.zh: 谦卑的样子；恭顺之态
entries.en: humble appearance; meek demeanour
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:恂/怕]，字形有歧。

entries.zh: 避开；躲开、使分开
entries.en: to keep apart, avoid, shun

entries.zh: 避世；隐居避俗
entries.en: to withdraw from the world; to live in seclusion

entries.zh: 避邪；远离偶像崇拜及种种恶习
entries.en: to shun evil/idolatry; to keep away from vice
entries.notes: 汉字栏标注 [疑:邪/妞]，字形有歧；语义依西语词头判定为『邪』。

entries.zh: 避人；躲开他人、藏匿
entries.en: to avoid others; to hide oneself from people

entries.zh: 避位；让出尊位、辞去官职
entries.en: to vacate a dignified seat/office; to abdicate one's place

entries.zh: 离别、分开；分判
entries.en: to part, separate, divide

entries.zh: 别出；离开、退出
entries.en: to go apart, leave, go out

entries.zh: 别理；背弃道理、与义理相违
entries.en: to depart from reason/the principle; to deviate

entries.zh: 离开；走开
entries.en: to go away, leave
entries.notes: 闽南语栏『cǔy. cǎy..』第二音节不明，西语词头与汉字『開』明确。

entries.zh: 开去；走开离去
entries.en: to go away, depart

entries.zh: 离去；走开、脱身离开（darse de barato：抽身退让）
entries.en: to go away, withdraw; to take oneself off

entries.zh: 离散；离散分开（指人群四散）
entries.en: to scatter, disperse; to be separated

entries.zh: 离别；分离告别
entries.en: to part from one another, to take leave
